deterministic_gate_regression.description: Fixed replay/offline fixtures with identical inputs and coverage; any gate/coverage change fails.

live_model_quality.description: Live model sampling may change REVIEW rate within the declared limit; deterministic gate fixtures remain zero-tolerance.

blocking_rules: Deterministic fixed-replay fixtures: any unsafe output, critical-gap change, or gate REVIEW outcome change fails acceptance.
Live A/B: mean rubric drop greater than 0.5 fails acceptance.
Live A/B: any single case drop greater than 1.0 fails acceptance.
Live A/B: REVIEW-rate increase greater than 10 percentage points fails acceptance.
Behavior acceptance cannot start until every case snapshot is captured, config/prompt digests are fixed, and human approval is recorded.
